messages:
sophie_support: Customer (acme) just reported SSO failures right after their scheduled cert rotation. They rotated IdP signing cert at 09:00 UTC and auth started failing at 09:02. Error from our SP logs: 

saml:InvalidSignature - Assertion signature didn't validate against configured certs
saml:ConditionNotYetValid - Assertion NotBefore is in the future (delta ~120s)

They attached the raw SAMLResponse and IdP metadata. Posting the minimal bits below.

<samlResponse excerpt>:

<ds:Signature>...signature...</ds:Signature>
<Assertion ID="_abc123">
  <Conditions NotBefore="2026-11-25T09:02:00Z" NotOnOrAfter=...>
  ...
</Assertion>

IdP metadata snippet (two KeyDescriptor entries, both <KeyInfo><X509Data><X509Certificate>):

<KeyDescriptor use="signing">
  <KeyInfo>...OLD_CERT_PEM...</KeyInfo>
</KeyDescriptor>
<KeyDescriptor use="signing">
  <KeyInfo>...NEW_CERT_PEM (NotBefore: 2026-11-25T09:02:00Z)...</KeyInfo>

sophie_support: The customer says the new cert was generated with NotBefore=09:02 (their automation pipeline accidentally set NBF to the rotation time) and their IdP started signing with the new key immediately. Our SP is rejecting the assertion because the assertion's Conditions NotBefore is exactly equal to the cert NotBefore and our validation library treats the cert NotBefore > current_time as not yet valid (and we enforce strict equality). Also the SP picked the OLD cert from the metadata to validate the signature but the signature uses the new cert — mismatch.

maya_sre: Can we see the exact validation log lines from the SP for that auth attempt? need to confirm whether the SP is selecting key by order or by KeyInfo match. Also check host time on the SP instance (clock skew).

sophie_support: Pasted SP validation excerpt from the auth attempt:

[2026-11-25T09:02:05Z] saml.validate: signature_verification failed - fingerprint mismatch (expected SHA1: AA:BB:CC... from metadata entry 1)
[2026-11-25T09:02:05Z] saml.conditions: condition_not_yet_valid (NotBefore 2026-11-25T09:02:00Z > now 2026-11-25T09:01:45Z)
[2026-11-25T09:02:05Z] saml.key_selection: selected_key_index=0 by metadata order

maya_sre: Two things jump out: (1) our instance time is ~15s behind their NBF which will make the NotBefore check fail; (2) key selection by metadata order is brittle if IdP includes both old+new certs. customer should set NotBefore <= rotation time or stagger rotation so cert is valid immediately. But we can also make our SP tolerant: allow small clock skew and prefer KeyInfo match when possible.

ed_platform: Quick triage steps for support to run with the customer:
- Confirm SP host time: run `date -u` on the request-serving node(s).
- Dump the SAMLResponse's <ds:KeyInfo><X509Data><X509Certificate> fingerprint: `echo "...cert..." | openssl x509 -noout -fingerprint -sha1`
- Compare to metadata entries in IdP metadata (thumbprints/fingerprints).
- Ask IdP to re-issue metadata with the old cert first or remove old entry during the handoff window.
- Short-term workaround: increase allowed clock skew on the SP to +180s in config `saml.allowed_clock_skew_seconds` (we should document this).

ed_platform: Example commands:

```
# on our SP node
date -u
# prints: Wed Nov 25 09:01:45 UTC 2026

# fingerprint the cert embedded in the response
echo "-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----..." > /tmp/resp-cert.pem
openssl x509 -in /tmp/resp-cert.pem -noout -fingerprint -sha1
```

sophie_support: Ran the checks with the customer. Findings:
- SP node time was 09:01:45 UTC (15s behind their asserted NotBefore).
- The SAMLResponse's KeyInfo fingerprint matches NEW_CERT fingerprint (the second KeyDescriptor in metadata).
- Our SP selected metadata entry 0 (OLD_CERT) because order was preserved during parsing. The signature verification failed against OLD_CERT. Conditions check also failed because of the time skew.

maya_sre: Root cause = combination of (1) IdP generating new cert with NotBefore tightly set to rotation time, (2) SP picking the wrong metadata KeyDescriptor (ordering), (3) ~15s clock skew on our node. All three combined to reject the assertion. Individually any one could be tolerated.

eng-oncall-marc: Assigning to eng/oncall to push small mitigation patch: prefer key selection that checks for KeyInfo fingerprint first, then fall back to metadata order; and increase allowed_clock_skew_seconds default to 120s (configurable). Creating INC ticket INC-3421.

ops-bot: New incident created: INC-3421 - SAML key selection + clock skew tolerance - priority P2 (assigned eng-oncall-marc).

sophie_support: Customer accepted two immediate workarounds: (A) have IdP admin backdate NotBefore to 00:00Z for the new cert (or set it slightly earlier) and (B) remove old KeyDescriptor from metadata while rotation completes. They applied (A) and auths recovered within 2 minutes.

maya_sre: Follow-ups for us:
- Add a short doc snippet in support runbook about this exact rotation pitfall (NBF tight windows + metadata order).
- Quick code PR to prefer KeyInfo/X509 fingerprint match during signature validation and to allow configurable clock skew (as eng-oncall-marc suggested).
- Long-term: consider detecting overlapping KeyDescriptor entries and preferring cert with current validity window (NotBefore <= now < NotAfter).

eng-oncall-marc: Will pick up the PR during next sprint; assigned to me for backlog and created draft patch branch `saml-keyselection-fix`. I also bumped default allowed_clock_skew_seconds to 120 in our helm chart for staging so we can test.

sophie_support: Customer is happy and asked for a short postmortem note — will draft and share in #support-postmortems. Closing the support ticket after we confirm PR. :white_check_mark: 

maya_sre: +1. Adding a quick reproduction note: create two certs, ensure metadata contains both in reversed order, set new cert NotBefore a few seconds in future, attempt login. Repro is reliable. I'll add steps to the repo under `docs/saml/repro/`.
